species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 57°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 60 ft, so fish stay above it.
